$comment: Operator decision log (scripts/analysis/decision-log.mjs; Spec 124 R-HK). Imported verbatim from the committed chat record docs/reports/decisions/raw/2026-10-22-batch-x/2026-10-22-batch-x.json. `decision_vocab`, `routing` (the register and row that record each decision), `amendments` and `options` are added by the lane and are not the operator's text; everything else is re-derived from `source.raw` by `--check`.

decisions.question: 1436/1437 (B)(ii) average interior floor area
decisions.recommendation: Keyer B: 110 m2 as the AVERAGE interior floor area, as written ('the average interior floor area of the dwelling unit and the secondary suites combined is at least 110 square metres'); condition of the 1960 multiple-suite permission, disclosed via the building-history If… route; twins keyed alike.

decisions.question: 1437 (B)(iii) per-unit floor area
decisions.recommendation: Keyer A: LIMIT interior_floor_area_m2 min 55 per unit, matching twin 1436 (B)(iii); condition of the 1960 permission, not applied by default.

decisions.question: 1436 (C)(ii)(b) vertical-division addition compliance
decisions.recommendation: Keyer A: building-history If… route (condition of the vertical-division permission) under the approved family ruling; twin 1437 (C)(ii)(b) alike.

decisions.question: 1436 (D) additions above first storey of lawfully existing house
decisions.recommendation: Keyer B: REQUIRE with the lawfully_existing condition — a genuine requirement ('must comply with the minimum building setbacks'), relevant to addition/renovation scenarios; as keyed before the re-key.

decisions.question: 1437 (D) twin of 1436 (D)
decisions.recommendation: Keyer B: REQUIRE with the lawfully_existing condition, identical to 1436 (D).
